notes.title: Update 1.10 - "Foundations Update"
notes.content:
Hi Athletes,
We’re excited to bring you a fresh update packed with quality-of-life improvements and new ways to play. Introducing the [b]Foundations Update[/b], a celebration of self-expression, smoother onboarding, and smarter ways to team up!

[b]Team Up with Bots – Now Available in Doubles[/b]
One of the most requested features is finally here: you can now add bots to doubles matches! Play with friends against bots, or have a bot join your team against your friends.

[b]Custom Racket Expansion – Now Across All Sports[/b]
Take your game to the next level with brand-new rackets for your favorite sports. 
[b]Pickleball, Spinminton, Box Tennis,[/b] and [b]Table Tennis[/b] now all support custom rackets that can be modified to fit your playstyle!

[h3]Key Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Play with or against bots in private doubles matches
[*] Practice doubles with 3 bots in the home area
[*] New rackets for Pickleball, Spinminton, and Table Tennis
[*] Customize the properties of any racket you own
[*] Expanded avatar customization options in the shop
[*] Redesigned court placement — no more recentering
[*] Performance and networking optimizations
[*] Regional public clubs for smoother online play
[*] A revamped first-time user experience
[*] Improved bot animations for smoother, less buggy visuals
[/list]
Enjoy the update, and don't forget to check the shop for all-new rackets and avatar gear!

More info and news can be found on the Racket Club discord. Come be a part of the community!
Thanks for helping us build a stronger foundation, we’ll see you on the court 🎾

notes.title: Update 1.9 - "Pickleball Update"
notes.content:
[h3]🏓 New Lab sport: Ping Pong[/h3]
[i]Chosen by community vote![/i]

[list]
[*]Doubles supported
[*]Official rules, including Doubles team serving rules
[*]Our first sport with editable racket parameters (Settings > Racket > Edit)
[/list]
[h3]🛒 New Shop room and experience[/h3]
[list]
[*]Complete Challenges to earn coins
[*]Purchase new Clothes
[*]New Skins, including new 👟
[*]Check your avatar in the new mirrors
[*]Rotate your avatar in the UI with the joystick
[/list]
[h3]🏡 New Club[/h3]

[h3]🥒 Pickleball graduates![/h3]
[list]
[*] Pickleball bot in training with all 4 difficulties
[*] Available on all multiplayer courts (club & private)
[*] Rules now supported with Gap Volley, Gap Serve, Serve Volley, Return Volley, & Serving from outside the court
[*] Pickleball Wide
[*] New ball with true holes 🙂
[*] Singles and Doubles Pickleball Leaderboard
[/list]
[h3]🤖 Spinminton Bot training with all 4 difficulties[/h3]
[list]
[*] Official Spinminton is Backwall OK
[/list]
[h3]🏋🏼‍♂️ Ball machine shot list now per sport[/h3]
[list]
[*] New default lists for each sport in singles & doubles
[*] On the Training court ball machine now available for Pickleball & Spinminton
[*] Higher max speed for the machine
[*] Shuffle shots order
[*] Edit time between shots
[/list]
[h3]🎲 You’re no longer randomly positioned when entering a court: [/h3]
[list]
[*] If the spot behind your entry point is available, you’ll be placed there, and if not, if the other spot on the court side is available you’ll go there
[/list]
[h3]⚙️ New Settings [/h3]
[list]
[*] Make the serve ball spawn safely away from you,so you can't miss hit your serve anymore
[*] Tweak the volume of off-court sounds to help you focus
[/list]
[h3]📏 Win by 2 is in! [/h3]

[h3]🐛 Known issues -> upcoming Patch[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some players do not get the new default Cannon shot
[*] Stopping a bot match can cause you to lose court switching options
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.8 - "Play Your Way"
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

🥼 New Lab experiment: Pickleball! Tried capturing the essence of Pickleball for our ‘Real Movements’ only Racket Club
👯 Host parties in Private courts. Create a Private with a 1v1 or 2v2 invite, then once you’re there invite spectators using the 'Invite to Court'. Rotate players by exiting the court as you do in the club.
⚙️  Spinminton mode & Wide court option graduate and are now available on all courts
➿ Switch between Singles or Doubles on all courts
🏸 Badminton racket for Spinminton
🏅 Leaderboards for Spinminton
⛹🏼‍♂️ Proper support for Spinminton’s ‘No Bounce’ rule
🧱  Raised Spinminton back wall
🤖 New Beginner bots trained from Beginner data
🥃 Serve line for Box Tennis & Pickleball Doubles with a new serve foul 'Close Serve' triggered if your serve impact is beyond the line.
⛔  Manage your Blocked users list individually
🐌  When not using an adapter, you no longer can extend the racket by more than 5cm
🐛 Fix a bug that prevented from playing offline if wifi was on but without internet

🎾 Please leave a review and spread the balls!!

notes.title: Here's what's new in our 'A New Spin' Update:
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Voting for match options: You can vote for the options of the match you're about to play.
[*] Racket Orientation Calibration: A tool that can be used to adjust the orientation of your racket with respect to your controller. This tool can help adjust the positioning of the racket when you use an adapter. You can save up to 3 presets.
[*] Private doubles matches: You can now invite 3 other friends to join you in a private doubles match.
[*] New Doubles Leaderboard
[*] New player profile design: Shows your progress in career and multiplayer, and also your win percentage in singles and doubles. More stats will be added to this profile over time.
[*] Drills in singles courts
[*] Membership Tier 7 with new cosmetics
[*] New and improved World Tour bot difficulty
[*] New Drills that require you to hit with minimum speed or spin
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]
